account: Rori is an AI-powered conversational math tutor on WhatsApp created by Rising Academies, an educational network based in Ghana. Henkel (University of Oxford), Horne-Robinson (Rising Academies), Kozhakhmetova and Lee (J-PAL North America) report a preliminary evaluation in 11 Rising Academies schools in Ghana. Students in grades 3–8 took a 35-question math assessment in early February 2023 (baseline) and late August 2023 (endline). 637 students (336 treatment, 301 control) took the baseline and 477 the endline. Treated students were given a phone for one hour a week during study hall to study math with Rori. Controls continued regular instruction. The May 2024 PDF (v2) reports an effect size of 0.36 (Cohen's d, p < 0.001) and a marginal cost of about $5 per student. The arXiv abstract still describes approximately 1,000 students in grades 3–9, two 30-minute sessions a week over 8 months and an effect size of 0.37. That does not match the v2 body.

ai_role.statement: Rori delivered the extra practice hour itself, so the comparison is Rori time versus a normal study hall. The authors call the result preliminary, year 1 only. The vendor co-authored the preprint.

claim_basis: Sources: two preprints from the makers and the makers' press release. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.

comparator.after: treatment group growth score M = 5.13 (SD = 7.03), an effect size of 0.36 (Cohen's d)
comparator.against: control-group students at schools without Rori access who continued regular math instruction
comparator.before: control group growth score M = 2.12 (SD = 6.30) between baseline and endline
comparator.quote: An independent samples t-test between the control (M = 2.12, SD = 6.30) and the treatment group (M = 5.13, SD = 7.03) revealed that the 3.01 difference in growth scores was highly statistically significant (p < 0.001).

evidence.citation: Henkel O, Horne-Robinson H, Kozhakhmetova N, Lee A (2024). Effective and Scalable Math Support: Evidence on the Impact of an AI-Tutor on Math Achievement in Ghana. arXiv:2402.09809 (abstract page; v1 15 Feb 2024, v2 5 May 2024).
evidence.quote: We find that the math growth scores were substantially higher for the treatment group with an effect size of 0.37, and that the results were statistically significant (p < 0.001).
evidence.title: Effective and Scalable Math Support: Evidence on the Impact of an AI-Tutor on Math Achievement in Ghana

headline: Rising Academies' WhatsApp tutor Rori lifts math scores 0.36 SD

later.note: By May 2026 Rising Academies was piloting Rori in government schools in Ghana's Eastern Region with World Bank support, had extended the pilot by six months, and was preparing a larger randomized trial in more than 100 public schools from September 2026.
later.quote: With World Bank support, Rising is piloting Rori, our AI-enabled virtual maths tutor, in government schools in Ghana’s Eastern Region. Due to strong engagement from schools and stakeholders, the pilot has been extended by six months through the end of the current academic year and will include an evaluation to inform future scale-up.

metric: an effect size of 0.36 (Cohen's d, p < 0.001)

fields.account: Rori is an AI-powered conversational math tutor on WhatsApp created by Rising Academies, an educational network based in Ghana. Henkel (University of Oxford), Horne-Robinson (Rising Academies), Kozhakhmetova and Lee (J-PAL North America) report a preliminary evaluation in 11 Rising Academies schools in Ghana. Students in grades 3–8 took a 35-question math assessment in early February 2023 (baseline) and late August 2023 (endline). 637 students (336 treatment, 301 control) took the baseline and 477 the endline. Treated students were given a phone for one hour a week during study hall to study math with Rori. Controls continued regular instruction. The May 2024 PDF (v2) reports an effect size of 0.36 (Cohen's d, p < 0.001) and a marginal cost of about $5 per student. The arXiv abstract still describes approximately 1,000 students in grades 3–9, two 30-minute sessions a week over 8 months and an effect size of 0.37. That does not match the v2 body.
